items.title: Ron Carter — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Georges Miquelle. Fabulous musician. I said, "Okay, if he can do that, I can do that."

ctx.x: About … I think you were fourteen and this is in your biography, you went to see the French cellist with the Detroit Symphony.
Georges Miquelle. Fabulous musician. I said, "Okay, if he can do that, I can do that."
So that was the impact on you?
